result.rationale: The before_validation block calls `self.host.sub!(/^https?:\/\//, '')` unconditionally on every save. If a record is created without a host value (e.g. controller's `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` nil, or a new model), `sub!` is invoked on nil, raising NoMethodError before the format validation can produce a proper error response. The Rails idioms `self.host.to_s.sub!` or `self.sub!` (which would leave nil intact and let validations fail gracefully) are not used.
